title: Ask to be kept by the Will
summary: Let quiet trust loosen the hand before it grips again. Do not let the day outrun this: hold onto this: serve first, and let peace expose the self.
takeaway: Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
lifeApplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.

source.shortMeaning: Peace begins when the self asks to be kept by Hukam.
source.lifeApplication: When pride hardens, ask to be held by the Will before you act.
